## ===== ImmoScout24 =====
## Beschreibung
Exclusive Living Above the Rooftops of ViennaThis exceptional penthouse combines contemporary architecture, premium finishes, and light-filled interiors to create an outstanding living experience. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows, a thoughtfully designed layout, and carefully selected materials offer the perfect balance of elegance, comfort, and functionality.
The private terrace is the highlight of the residence, providing the ideal setting to relax while enjoying panoramic views across Vienna's skyline.
Features
- Premium herringbone hardwood flooring

- Underfloor heating & air conditioning

- Designer bathrooms with elegant tiling

- Smart KNX home automation system

- Electric external blinds

- Video intercom system

- Private terrace with electricity and water connections

As part of the penthouse development, the entire building has been comprehensively renovated and now presents itself as a modern residential property that seamlessly combines timeless architecture with contemporary living standards.
A residence designed for those who appreciate sophisticated urban living, exceptional design, and uncompromising quality.
Wir weisen darauf hin, dass zwischen dem Vermittler und dem zu vermittelnden Dritten ein familiäres oder wirtschaftliches Naheverhältnis besteht.
Der Vermittler ist als Doppelmakler tätig.

## Lage
It is located in Vienna's 17th district (Hernals), offering excellent public transport connections. The nearby tram lines **2, 9, and 43** provide direct access to the city centre and other key destinations.

The neighborhood features supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, schools, and everyday amenities within walking distance. Nearby green spaces include **Kongresspark**, **Türkenschanzpark**, and **Schwarzenbergpark**, offering ample opportunities for recreation and outdoor activities.
